summary: Mass-Driver's black, almost monochrome microsite for MD Polychrome, a MICR-inspired 'retro high-tech' display face whose four styles (Nano, Kilo, Mega, Giga) vary optical size instead of weight. A chrome light-speed intro video opens the page; below, a sticky nav set in the font, short design notes with an animated MICR scanner diagram, auto-fitting editable specimen lines per size, a hover-to-toggle OpenType tile grid and three CTA lines. Unlike its sibling MD Nichrome, colour comes only from rendered chrome images and pink link accents.
